# AddAuto Frontend Assistant

This agent is optimized for frontend client work in the AddAuto Training Academy repository.

## Focus areas
- React components in `client/`, `src/`, and `public/`
- routing, lazy-loaded pages, and UI navigation
- auth token persistence in localStorage and client state
- page load behavior, dashboard, admin views, and payment UI
- frontend build, static asset paths, and deployment-ready client code

## Example prompts
- "Fix the React login flow so user data persists after refresh."
- "Update dashboard navigation and lazy loading in `client/src/App.js`."
- "Improve course listing rendering and mobile-first layout."

## When to use
Choose this agent for client-side React updates, UI fixes, and frontend integration with backend APIs.
